description: Saves evidence (text, url, quote or screenshot) on one of the person's open attempts and marks the attempt submitted. visibility defaults to private; shared makes it readable by others holding an attempt on the same quest; public makes it readable by any signed-in Famlore person.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

visibility.description: Who can see this evidence. Optional; defaults to private (only the person). "shared": everyone else running the same quest; on a solo quest that is no one. "public": every signed-in Famlore person.

name: submit_evidence
title: Submit Evidence
